scanNote:
1-MODUL MUQOVASINING O'NG BETI. Bet raqami bosilmagan.

Betda:
• O'ng yuqorida: 'Module 1' (pushti va yashil), ostida 'Units 1 - 4'
• 'Learn how to ...' — to'rtta muloqot maqsadi
• 'Practise ...' — sakkizta grammatika mavzusi
• 3-UNIT: 'Home, Sweet Home!' sarlavhasi; ikkita surat — gulli balkonli shveysar uslubidagi yog'och uy va suvda turgan qora-qizil tor qayiq (Britaniya kanal qayig'i). Yonida: 'houses around the world & their special features', 'furniture & appliances'
• 4-UNIT: 'Like Father, Like Son!' sarlavhasi; ikkita surat — koptok o'ynayotgan ikki qizcha va uch avlod oilaviy surati. Yonida: 'families & relationships', 'likes & dislikes'

⚠⚠ KITOB XATOSI (imlo): 'Learn how to' ro'yxatida 'ask for and give ADRESSES & phone numbers' deb yozilgan. To'g'risi — ADDRESSES (ikkita 'd'). Kesib kattalashtirib tekshirdim.

⚠ FOYDALI TASDIQ: sarlavha 'Practise ...' — FE'L shakli 's' bilan to'g'ri yozilgan. Bu 166-betdagi 'practice (ot) / practise (fe'l)' qoidasining amaliy misoli.

⚠ 'Units 1 - 4' — modul tarkibi yana bir bor tasdiqlanadi.

⚠ KIChIK NOMUVOFIQLIK: bu yerda 'Home, Sweet Home!' (vergul bilan) va 'Like Father, Like Son!' (ikkinchi 'Like' BOSh harf bilan); mundarijada esa 'Home Sweet Home' (vergulsiz) va 'Like Father, like Son' (kichik 'like').

exercises.instructionEn: Module 1, Units 1-4. Learn how to ... Practise ... Unit 3: Home, Sweet Home!  Unit 4: Like Father, Like Son!
exercises.instructionUz: 1-modul, 1-4-unitlar. Nimani o'rganasiz... Nimani mashq qilasiz... 3-unit: Uyginam, shirin uyginam!  4-unit: Otasiga o'xshaydi!
exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET — 1-MODUL MUQOVASINING O'NG
BETI.

  Bu yerda modulning MAQSADLARI va
  3-4-unitlar berilgan.


⚠ 'MODULE 1 — UNITS 1 - 4'

  ⚠ Modul tarkibi yana bir bor
  tasdiqlanadi: 1-modulda TO'RT unit.

  ⚠ Eslatma: 4-modulda esa UChTA unit
  (13-15). Shuning uchun orqa muqovadagi
  'four units each' da'vosi noto'g'ri.


'LEARN HOW TO ...' — TO'RT MAQSAD:

  • introduce people
     = odamlarni tanishtirish
  • greet; say goodbye
     = salomlashish; xayrlashish
  • ask for and give adresses &
    phone numbers
     = manzil va telefon raqamini so'rash
       va aytish
  • identify people
     = odamlarni tanib olish

  ⚠ Bu to'rttasi 3-betdagi mundarijaning
  'COMMUNICATION' ustunidagi 1-4-unit
  bandlariga AYNAN mos keladi.


⚠⚠ KITOB XATOSI (imlo):

  Kitobda: 'ask for and give ADRESSES'

  ⚠ To'g'risi: ADDRESSES — IKKITA 'd'.

  ⚠ Kesib kattalashtirib tekshirdim —
  kitobda aniq bitta 'd' bosilgan.

  ⚠ 'an address' = manzil
     ad-dress: 'ad-' + 'dress'

  ⚠ 144-betdagi Britaniya xat manzilida
  bu so'z to'g'ri ishlatilgan edi.


'PRACTISE ...' — SAKKIZ GRAMMATIKA
MAVZUSI:

  • a-an/plurals
  • to be/have (got)/can
  • this/these - that/those
  • there is/there are
  • possessive adjectives/pronouns
  • possessive case
  • prepositions of place
  • present simple


⚠⚠ FOYDALI TASDIQ — 'PRACTISE':

  Sarlavhada 'PRACTISE ...' — 's' bilan.

  ⚠ Bu TO'G'RI, chunki bu yerda FE'L
  (buyruq gapi: 'mashq qiling').

  ⚠ 166-betdagi qoida:
     'practiCe' — OT ('c' bilan)
     'practiSe' — FE'L ('s' bilan)

  ⚠ Bu — o'sha qoidaning AMALIY misoli.


UNIT 3 — 'Home, Sweet Home!'

  Mavzular:
     • houses around the world & their
       special features
     • furniture & appliances

  SURATLAR:
     1) ShVEYSAR USLUBIDAGI YOG'OCh UY
        Keng qiya tom, balkonda gullar.
        ⚠ 'a chalet' [SHA-ley] deb ataladi
        (fransuzcha so'z, 't' JIM).

     2) TOR QORA-QIZIL QAYIQ
        Suv ustida turgan uzun qayiq.
        ⚠ 'a narrowboat' = Britaniya kanal
        qayig'i. Odamlar unda YAShAYDI!

  ⚠ Ikki surat 'houses around the world'
  mavzusini ochadi: uy har xil bo'lishi
  mumkin — hatto qayiq ham.

  ⚠ 135-136-betlardagi Photo File
  varaqlari shu unitga tegishli.


UNIT 4 — 'Like Father, Like Son!'

  Mavzular:
     • families & relationships
     • likes & dislikes

  SURATLAR:
     1) Koptok o'ynayotgan ikki qizcha
     2) UCh AVLOD oilaviy surati:
        buvi-bobo, ota-ona va bolalar

  ⚠ 'likes & dislikes' = yoqadigan va
  yoqmaydigan narsalar.
     'to like' → 'likes' (OT!)
     'to dislike' → 'dislikes'

  ⚠ 'dis-' = inkor qo'shimchasi.


⚠ KIChIK NOMUVOFIQLIKLAR:

  Bu yerda:  'Home, Sweet Home!'
     (VERGUL bilan)
  Mundarijada: 'Home Sweet Home'
     (vergulsiz)

  Bu yerda:  'Like Father, Like Son!'
     (ikkinchi 'Like' BOSh harf)
  Mundarijada: 'Like Father, like Son'
     (kichik 'like')

  ⚠ Ma'no o'zgarmaydi — faqat yozilish
  farqi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an address    = manzil
  to greet      = salomlashmoq
  to identify   = tanib olmoq
  to practise   = mashq qilmoq (FE'L)
  practice      = mashq (OT)
  a chalet      = shveysar uslubidagi uy
  a narrowboat  = kanal qayig'i
  furniture     = mebel
  an appliance  = maishiy texnika
  a relationship = munosabat, qarindoshlik
  likes and dislikes = yoqadigan va
                  yoqmaydigan narsalar
  a generation  = avlod
  possessive    = egalik bildiruvchi
